contained-t-check.desc: Verifies that nothing inside a `t` module calls a free function from our crate.
contained-t-check.rationale: Since impls must be in a `t` module (see impl_location check), this check encourages methods to be simpler helper functions. My preference is for larger functionality not to be in methods but in free functions elsewhere in the codebase.

exceptions.exception: The free function is in the same `t` module
We don't own the free function (e.g. it's from a dependency or std)
